title: WebSocket
concept: WebSocket client and server in XIOM — persistent bidirectional connections for real-time communication, live updates, and streaming data.
why: HTTP is request-response. WebSocket is continuous. For chat, live feeds, games, and collaboration tools, WebSocket provides the real-time connection HTTP can't.
tips: WebSocket URLs use ws:// (unencrypted) or wss:// (TLS encrypted) — prefer wss:// in production
Handle disconnections gracefully — network connections drop, implement reconnection logic
Use JSON for structured messages — raw strings don't scale for complex protocols
Ping/pong frames keep idle connections alive — most clients handle this automatically
common_mistakes: Not handling client disconnection — stale connections accumulate and leak memory
Assuming message delivery order — WebSocket is ordered, but network issues can cause reordering in reconnect scenarios
Sending large messages without considering frame size limits — fragment large payloads
